Lord Jagannath's Snana Purnima observed with rituals and sand art

Devotees observed the Snana Purnima ritual, a sacred bath for Lord Jagannath, which marks the beginning of his divine journey. Sand artist Sudarshan Patnaik created a sand sculpture to honor the occasion. The event is a significant religious observance.
